facts.text: Audrey has owned three dogs named Pepper, Precious, and Panda for three years.

evidence.quote: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda.

facts.text: Audrey and her dogs frequently go on adventures, including exploring new parks and trails.

evidence.quote: They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.

facts.text: Audrey's dogs are described as bringing a lot of happiness to her life.

evidence.quote: It's great how much happiness they bring.
